items.scene: A dancer carries a plate of QUICHE ("KWEES") and pats her strong THIGH.
A BARBER ("BAHRB") with comb and scissors trims an old man's enormous BEARD, curls tumbling to the floor.
A MOOSE ("MOOS") with a huge curly MOUSTACHE twirls its ends in a hand mirror.
Mother crocodile, 'MA' ("mah"), opens her huge JAW wide under a garden SHOWER ("SHWAHR") to rinse her teeth.
A little dragon's warm BREATH melts A LANE ("ah-LEHN") through the icicles on the frosted glass door.
A curious horse flares one big NOSTRIL to sniff a ripe NECTARINE ("-ta-REEN") held up on a palm.
A cheerleader waves her red POM-pom ("poh") high, smiling with rosy CHEEKBONES at the friend she just MET ("MEHT").
A strongMAN ("mahn") juts out his huge square CHIN as he balances a one-TON ("TOHN") iron ball on his forehead.
A PUMA ("poo-MOHN") fills its LUNGS with a huge breath and has blown up two pink balloons that bob above its head.

prompt:
Gentle storybook painterly illustration, realism about 3.5/5, soft gouache-and-oil brushwork, warm-hearted and calm, natural NEUTRAL daylight with true colours, off-white whites, no orange, sepia, amber or golden cast, no pink or blue tint, clear readable figures with contact shadows on the floor, consistent eye-level perspective, 16:9 wide composition.
Scene: L'atelier de l'illustrateur in the B17_cabinet building, first floor (east studio). Camera: inside the studio, facing the big north skylight.
Setting: pale wheat-yellow plaster between exposed oak beams, white plaster casts of faces on shelves; floor: grey floorboards dotted with paint spatters. Landmark: a huge sloping north skylight over a tall easel holding a big painted portrait of a bearded face. Light: cool even light from the north skylight. The room feels lived-in and real, with depth (never an empty white backdrop).
Paint these exits clearly as walkable openings: the oxblood arch edge in the near left foreground (way to Le cabinet d'anatomie).
Characters and objects, each a separate, clearly spaced group, feminine-word groups on the left half and masculine-word groups on the right half:
- far left, middle distance: A dancer models a lunge for the illustrator, one strong THIGH forward, munching a slice of QUICHE.
- left, middle distance: A BARBER with comb and scissors trims an old man's enormous BEARD, curls tumbling to the floor.
- left, foreground: A MOOSE with a huge curly MOUSTACHE twirls its ends in a hand mirror.
- centre, middle distance: Mother crocodile, 'MA', opens her huge JAW wide under a garden SHOWER to rinse her teeth.
- centre, foreground: A little dragon's warm BREATH melts A LANE through the frost on the studio window.
- right, middle distance: A curious horse flares one big NOSTRIL to sniff a ripe NECTARINE held up on a palm.
- right, foreground: A cheerleader's red POM-pom brushes her high, rosy CHEEKBONE as she smiles at the friend she just MET.
- far right, middle distance: A MAN with a huge square CHIN balances a one-TON iron weight on it.
- far right, foreground: A PUMA takes a huge breath, and its two LUNGS show through its chest like two big pink balloons.
Leave a blank light board for the room sign high on the back wall. No written words, letters, numbers or logos anywhere (signs and plaques are blank boards). No blood, no wounds, no needles in skin (syringes only as capped harmless props), no alcohol, no smoking, no religious symbols, no red-cross emblem. Nobody cropped by the image edge; keep every figure well inside the frame with a clear gap between figures. Figures stand on the floor or sit on real furniture, never floating or in rows behind a counter.
